790318471349.name: Character Modeler - Netflix Animation Studios
790318471349.job_description:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

Are you interested in working on Netflix Animation Studios’ next animated feature with our highly talented team of artists? We are looking for Character Modeling Artists who love building appealing stylised characters from strong proportions and clean forms to production-ready topology and UVs. Experience with Marvelous Designer is a plus. This role is focused on creating complete production-ready character models for our upcoming projects. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Interpret 2D designs and translate them into 3D space while maintaining the original artistic intent. 

  • Produce complex or stylised character models to a high standard with a strong understanding of appeal, silhouette, proportion, shape and scale.

  • Produce accurate UVs for models for use in downstream departments. 

  • Produce highly optimised meshes with clean production-ready topology that can be rendered and displayed efficiently for downstream departments such as Rigging, Layout and Lighting.

  • Assume responsibility for ensuring assigned work is produced to the appropriate standard quality within the scheduled timeframe and deadline. 

  • Maintain good communication with the Leadership team.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years’ experience modelling within a VFX or Animated Feature pipeline 

  • Proficiency with Maya and ZBrush 

  • Experience with Marvelous Designer 

  • Strong understanding of character appeal, silhouette, proportion, and shape language

  • Solid understanding of proper edge flow and polygon density 

  • Solid understanding of the topology for static and deforming objects 

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to abstract and interpret design down to its fundamentals 

  • Strong organizational and time management skills 

What you’ll need to include on your application: 

Turntables, with wireframes, of character and creature models 

This role is based out of Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office). 

NAS benefits can include medical/dental/vision plans, mental health support, retirement programs, and family-forming benefits, paid leave of absence programs, and paid time away programs to be used for vacation and sick paid time off. See more detail about our benefits here. 

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

790317562984.name: Manager, Title, Slate + Brand Marketing - Australia + New Zealand
790317562984.posting_name: Manager, Title, Slate + Brand Marketing - Australia + New Zealand
790317562984.job_description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

We're actively seeking a highly strategic and creative marketing manager with solid media buying experience to join our ANZ Marketing Team as Manager, Title, Slate + Brand Marketing - Australia + New Zealand. 

As the media buying expert in the team, in addition to managing campaigns you will also work with our marketing team and media agency to develop best practices, connect paid social to our overall marketing strategy, explore and leverage key media partners, build learning agendas, and to scale campaigns and ideas.

Our ideal candidate is an analytical thinker, adept at leveraging data and insights to uncover the most impactful and engaging marketing strategies. It is expected that a successful candidate will be developing detailed media plans and guiding our agencies on operational specifics related to smooth campaign execution, so a knowledge of platform setup is required for the role.  

We highly encourage reading the Who We Are section of the Netflix website and learning about the Netflix Culture to ensure that all candidates feel that Netflix is a good fit. 

Core Responsibilities: 

  • Lead local film, series and brand campaigns, conceiving and delivering integrated 360 campaigns from audience and creative strategy through to media execution, including bespoke creative built for paid placements

  • Manage and work with creative and media agencies to deliver campaigns

  • Act as the primary liaison for our media agency to improve workflows for audience identification, planning and measure the performance of our campaigns, while identifying new ways of working and long-term opportunities to drive greater impact through our media planning and buying 

  • Directly execute, build, and optimise paid social campaigns in-platform across Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and X

  • Build direct relationships with key stakeholders at digital platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, X) to unlock beta features, early access, and opportunities for scalable digital innovation

  • Serve as the team's platform expert on paid social, advising cross-functional partners on audience targeting, platform capabilities, and format specs

  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional partners across regional marketing, publicity, content and social 

  • Bring a culture-first lens to campaign ideas, in partnership with creative leadership and cross-functional partners like PR and Events, to develop concepts that spark cultural conversation

Skills and Requirements:

  • 10+ years in media/paid social buying and planning, with deep expertise in biddable media, audience targeting, full-funnel strategy, and performance KPIs. Entertainment industry experience (TV, film, gaming, sport) a plus

  • Hands-on proficiency in Meta, TikTok, and YouTube's ad management platforms, with fluency in channel-specific creative formats and paid social best practices

  • Analytical and data-driven, comfortable making fast, confident decisions in a high-volume, fast-paced environment

  • An entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset - proactive, resourceful, and energized by ambiguity and data

  • A genuine passion for TV, film, and storytelling, and curiosity about the broader Netflix business

  • A collaborative leader and project manager who brings out the best in cross-functional partners

  • Experience conceiving or shaping creative ideas for paid media, particularly culture-driven concepts, is a strong plus.
